creationInfo.comment:
Component-level SBOM for the Microchip fork of ARM Trusted
Firmware-A. Packages and licenses were derived from the in-tree
SPDX-License-Identifier tags, the LICENSE/COPYING files, and per-component
copyright notices. FilesAnalyzed is false for every package (no per-file
hashing); the SBOM is at package granularity. No package-manager manifests
exist in this source tree, so automated scanners under-report it.

packages.comment:
Microchip fork of ARM Trusted Firmware-A v2.8.17. The
project's primary license is BSD-3-Clause; the aggregate distribution also
includes the separately-listed bundled components below, plus a few
dual-licensed device-tree binding headers (GPL-2.0-or-later OR MIT, and MIT)
under include/dt-bindings and the microchip platform dirs.
packages.copyrightText:
Copyright (c) 2013-2022, Arm Limited and Contributors. All rights reserved.
Copyright (C) 2021-2026 Microchip Technology Inc. and its subsidiaries.
packages.name: sw-arm-trusted-firmware

packages.comment:
Cryptographic library used by the trusted boot chain. Cloned
at build time (not committed) into mbedtls/; the build pins tag mbedtls-2.28.0.
packages.name: mbedtls

packages.copyrightText: Copyright (C) 1995-2022 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler
packages.name: zlib
packages.originator: Person: Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler

packages.comment:
Flattened device tree access library (from dtc), vendored
under lib/libfdt and include/lib/libfdt. The related FIT-image helper under
lib/libfit carries the same dual license.
packages.name: libfdt

packages.comment:
Compiler builtins (e.g. 64-bit integer helpers) from LLVM
compiler-rt, vendored under lib/compiler-rt/builtins.
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2009-2016 by the contributors listed in CREDITS.TXT
packages.name: compiler-rt-builtins

packages.comment:
TF-A minimal C library, vendored under lib/libc and
include/lib/libc; predominantly BSD-3-Clause with a few ISC and
BSD-2-Clause-FreeBSD files.
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) the Regents of the University of California and Arm Limited
packages.name: tf-a-libc

packages.comment:
STMicroelectronics clock drivers and device-tree bindings
